description: Mendaftar wilayah satu tingkat di bawah kode (provinsi → kab/kota → kecamatan → desa/kelurahan), dengan halaman. Lists the direct children of a code, paginated with offset/batas. Without kode it lists the 38 provinces. Offline, free.

kode.description: Parent code, e.g. "32" or "32.73.01". Leave empty for all provinces.

offset.description: Start position (use next_offset from the previous page).

name: daftar_anak
title: Daftar wilayah di bawah kode / List children
